newsitem.title: UK: VCI says Christmas season slower than yr ago.
newsitem.headline: VCI says Christmas season slower than yr ago.

text.p: VCI Plc, a video, book and audio publishing group, said on Wednesday that early indications are that the critical Christmas shopping season has been slower than last year to gather full momentum.
However, it said it continued to believe that the company's objectives for 1996 are achievable.
VCI said that in the 10 months to October 31, the group's trading from its catalogues and all its other business areas was ahead of expectations.
The company made pre-tax profits of eight million stg on turnover of 76.6 million in the year ended 31 December 1995.
By 1103 GMT, shares in the company had slipped 14p to 274-1/2.
